personality_one_liner: An addictive, vibrant, friendly math game that makes arithmetic lightning-fast and fun for all ages.

spacing.rule: Generous and touch-friendly padding, rounded containers, chunky cards with clear separation and touch targets >= 44pt

do's: Use solid tactile cards with 24pt radius
Use chunky pill buttons with spring press feedback
dont's: Avoid glass blur for this high-speed gaming arcade feel
Avoid low contrast text on pastel surfaces

screens.name: SplashLoading
screens.purpose: Animated splash screen welcoming players and checking local storage state.

states.error: Failed to load local data. Tap Retry.

screens.layout: Centered playful brand logo with bounce animation, progress indicator, and smooth transition to Home or First Launch.

screens.name: FirstLaunchAgeSelection
screens.purpose: Select player age group (6-7, 8-10, 11-13, 14-16, 17-20, 21+) to calibrate starting difficulty.

states.error: Could not save age preference. Tap Retry.

screens.layout: Vertical scrollable list of vibrant age tier cards with difficulty description badges and large tap targets.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Central game hub showing daily streaks (3-day & 7-day), personal bests, play button, and admin access.

states.empty: No games played yet! Tap Play 60s Challenge to start.
states.error: Failed to load profile data. Tap Retry.

screens.layout: Top header with settings & admin button, Streak banner card (3-day / 7-day challenge progress), Hero 'Play 60-Second Challenge' banner, and personal best summary card.

screens.name: Game
screens.purpose: Fast-paced 60-second timed math challenge with score, combo multiplier, lives, and 4 multiple-choice answers.

states.error: Question generation error. Tap to continue.

screens.layout: Top status bar (Timer countdown, score, combo badge, lives hearts), Question card with large arithmetic expression, 2x2 grid of chunky answer buttons, and bottom sticky area.

screens.name: FeedbackState
screens.purpose: Instant correct/wrong visual and audio feedback state with floating point bonuses or life loss.
screens.layout: Overlay modal or flash banner with success/error colors, combo increment indicator, and instant auto-advance to next question.

screens.name: Results
screens.purpose: Post-game breakdown showing final score, correct answers count, accuracy percentage, best combo, personal best, and prominent Play Again CTA.

states.error: Failed to save score. Tap Retry.

screens.layout: Celebration header, Score summary card with XP earned, stats breakdown grid (Accuracy, Best Combo, Correct answers), and prominent sticky Play Again & Home buttons.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Local settings for sound, vibration, privacy policy links, age group switcher, and reset progress.

states.error: Failed to update settings. Tap Retry.

screens.layout: Grouped setting toggles (Sound effects, Haptics), Age group picker, Data management (Reset progress), and Legal/Privacy links.

screens.name: AdminDashboard
screens.purpose: Separate secure admin login and dashboard to manage age categories, questions database, streak challenges, and monetization settings.
screens.layout: Tabs for Categories, Questions, Challenges, and Monetization configuration with CRUD modals and AI-assisted authoring mock.

math_streak_icon.alt: Colorful number blocks for streak challenge

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Maths Game exact specification in /app/frontend. Features required: local validated question engine across 6 age groups (6-7, 8-10, 11-13, 14-16, 17-20, 21+), 60-Second Challenge with timer, live score, combo multiplier, lives, speed bonuses, correct/wrong feedback state, results screen with personal best and XP calculation, daily streaks (3-day and 7-day challenges), local settings (sound, vibration, reset progress, age switcher), and separate admin login/dashboard for question and challenge management. Use Tactile Playful design with vibrant colors, rounded cards, and 44pt+ touch targets. Fully offline capable with AsyncStorage persistence.
